sourcePolicy: User-supplied local videos; never modify originals or distribute episodes/extracted frames in Git/releases

qualityTruth.positive: Comparable observed temporal action with reviewable half-open bounds; not a similar isolated still alone
qualityTruth.negative: Comparable appearance or pose but an observably different action, or a reviewed mismatching temporal sequence
qualityTruth.uncertain: Insufficient visibility or ambiguous action; never coerce into a negative
qualityTruth.reviewerDisclosure: Name the actual reviewer; assistant inspection is not independently confirmed human annotation
qualityTruth.unjudgedRetrieved: Retain as unjudged; do not automatically count as false positives
qualityTruth.tuning: S01E01/S01E02 only; freeze annotations before threshold changes
qualityTruth.holdout: S01E03/S01E04; freeze annotations and scoring policy before testing the changed matcher

cacheScenarios: multi-day retention (distinguish simulated age from elapsed days)
changed test copy of exactly one source
requiredEvidence: peak process RAM and sampled per-process WDDM VRAM
output equality for compatible cache/no-cache runs
settingsIsolation: Separate benchmark settings and cache roots; never copy tokens or alter personal preferences
